runtimeQualification.scope: Imported bytecode identity in the isolated lab with checked static Preview preparation, scoped cue edits and tracking controls, native channel inspection, and paged cue checkpoints. Feature and platform scope is documented in the qualification record.
limitations: Physical checks and show merging are deferred.

Large native reads are bounded by capture time, part count, data size and reconstruction limits.
Only the documented onPC 2.5.1.1 lab deployment was tested in this pass.
